name: WdMergeFormatFrom
description: Specifies the document from which to retain formatting during a document compare function.

constants.name: wdMergeFormatFromOriginal
constants.description: Retains formatting from the original document.

constants.name: wdMergeFormatFromRevised
constants.description: Retains formatting from the revised document.

constants.name: wdMergeFormatFromPrompt
constants.description: Prompt the user for the document to use for formatting.
